result.reasoning: Before this commit, `mCurPage = prevPage` (along with `removeView` and `onDetach`) was executed immediately when popping a page, prior to any animation delay. This commit refactored the pop logic to move these operations into `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal`, which is only invoked after the animation delay (via postDelayed) when an animation is playing. This means `mCurPage` was no longer set to null/prevPage immediately, but only after the transition animation completed — exactly the bug the fix commit corrects by moving `mCurPage = prevPage` (and removeView) back to execute immediately, independent of the animation.
